instruction: Fix `normalize` in `codec/text.py` so it composes characters to NFC rather than decomposing to NFD. Precomposed input (e.g. a precomposed 'e-acute') is currently turned into a base letter plus a combining mark, which breaks NFC round-tripping.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/text.py b/codec/text.py
--- a/codec/text.py
+++ b/codec/text.py
@@ -17,4 +17,4 @@
 
 def normalize(text: str) -> str:
     """Return the NFC-normalised form of ``text``."""
-    return unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text)
+    return unicodedata.normalize("NFC", text)
